agent.name: Emerging Technology Creation Agent
agent.specialty: Technology creation, predecessor capabilities, enabling forces, and contextual interpretation; MCP and REST comparison

analytical_question: How did MCP emerge from existing integration technologies and the needs of tool-using AI, and what does REST’s history suggest about the durability of MCP’s role in enterprise applications? The bounded management decision is whether to investigate a replaceable MCP adapter over existing banking capabilities during the assumed 6–12-month pilot, while preserving a direct integration route over the assumed three-year maintenance horizon. This analysis does not settle procurement, readiness, or production deployment.
general_et_finding: MCP is a protocol; an MCP server is its implementation, an API is an interface, REST is an architectural style, and HTTP is a transport. Dated sequence: Fielding documented REST in 2000; JSON-RPC 2.0’s published origin date is 2010, based on a 2009 version; Toolformer research appeared in February 2023; Anthropic launched MCP on November 25, 2024. These establish available predecessor capabilities, not proof that each directly inspired MCP. Anthropic attributed creation to David Soria Parra and Justin Spahr-Summers and described bespoke integrations and isolated information as motivations. Its efficiency claims are creator statements, not measured benefits. The scientific enabling condition was demonstrated language-model tool use; economic and organizational drivers plausibly include connector maintenance and information fragmentation; market incentives plausibly include reusable access across competing assistants. Those latter causal interpretations remain inference. The verified 2026-07-28 architecture combines host/client/server separation, JSON-RPC, discovery, tool descriptions with JSON Schemas, invocation, and resources/prompts. It supports stdio and Streamable HTTP and describes stateless requests with version/capability metadata. Its context-exchange scope leaves model orchestration to applications; structured calls do not establish deterministic reasoning. REST pursues reuse and independent evolution through statelessness, cacheability, a uniform interface including hypermedia, and layering. These entail overhead and stale-cache trade-offs. MCP’s method-oriented interface differs; using HTTP or JSON does not establish REST conformance. Comparison inference: both can isolate implementations behind shared contracts; MCP adds an agent-facing contract over existing APIs, but introduces adapter maintenance and compatibility work. Neither creates missing legacy interfaces. Durability is conditional: verified reuse across independently evolving hosts would favor MCP; incompatible evolution or a superior agent-facing interface would undermine its exact specification. Continued integration demand is more defensible than survival of any particular server. REST’s rationale alone cannot establish why REST succeeded commercially or predict MCP permanence.
application_finding: In the proposed read-only workflow, a server could map narrowly described lookup tools to approved existing customer, promotion, and eligibility capabilities. MCP’s added mechanism is reusable agent-facing discovery and invocation, rather than replacement banking APIs. The bank’s system remains authoritative for eligibility and documented potential savings; the assistant would explain returned information and produce descriptive insights, with separate business logic and orchestration needed to constrain the workflow. Reuse is an opportunity hypothesis, not measured savings. Direct API integration could suffice for one controlled assistant with a small stable capability set, particularly when discovery and cross-host reuse add little value. MCP cannot supply an approved callable interface where none exists, infer eligibility from demographics, or make model explanations reliably correct by itself.
organization_specific_finding: All organization-specific statements are hypothetical case assumptions: an established branch bank, conservative adoption posture, limited pilot resources, and banker review. Existing legacy functions are supplied context; approved APIs, delegated authentication, and audit facilities remain unknown. Under these assumptions, creation history supports investigating a small replaceable adapter rather than tying bank rules to an evolving agent-facing protocol. A three-year maintenance perspective increases the relevance of version support and exit costs, while the initial read-only boundary limits authorized functionality without eliminating confidentiality or misinformation consequences. Banker review is assumed, not a verified or sufficient control. The history does not establish this bank’s compatibility, staff capability, compliance, or readiness. Keep enrollment, money movement, and record changes outside this case.

evidence.claim: MCP was launched on November 25, 2024; Anthropic identified its creators and presented custom integrations and isolated data as the problem.
evidence.source_or_reference: Anthropic, Introducing the Model Context Protocol: https://www.anthropic.com/news/model-context-protocol
evidence.evidence_type: Primary-source fact for launch/attribution; creator statement for motivation and proposed benefits.
evidence.notes: Supports a dated origin and stated intent; does not independently establish causation, bank benefits, current adoption, or future dominance.

evidence.claim: The pinned architecture specifies JSON-RPC-based discovery and primitives, tool schemas and calls, and stateless request metadata; tools may invoke APIs.
evidence.notes: Documents protocol mechanisms and excludes LLM/context management from scope. It is not an interoperability test or evidence that the bank implements them.

evidence.claim: JSON-RPC predates MCP and defines structured method requests, correlated responses, and notifications independently of transport.
evidence.source_or_reference: JSON-RPC Working Group, JSON-RPC 2.0 Specification: https://www.jsonrpc.org/specification
evidence.date_or_recency: Origin 2010-03-26, based on 2009-05-24; updated 2013-01-04; accessed live 2026-10-05.
evidence.notes: MCP’s documented use makes JSON-RPC a technical dependency; age does not demonstrate MCP durability.

evidence.claim: REST’s constraints address independent evolution and scale, with uniform-interface and layering overhead and stale-cache trade-offs.
evidence.source_or_reference: Roy Fielding, dissertation chapter 5, Representational State Transfer: https://ics.uci.edu/~fielding/pubs/dissertation/rest_arch_style.htm
evidence.notes: Explains architectural properties rather than longitudinal market success; these constraints are not inherited merely by using HTTP.

evidence.claim: Tool-using language models were demonstrated before MCP’s launch.
evidence.source_or_reference: Schick et al., Toolformer: Language Models Can Teach Themselves to Use Tools: https://arxiv.org/abs/2302.04761
evidence.notes: Research demonstrates learning API use in studied tasks. It does not establish direct influence on MCP, banking reliability, or deterministic execution.

evidence.claim: A replaceable agent-facing adapter may preserve integration options if backend contracts and business logic remain independent.
evidence.source_or_reference: Creation-agent inference from the cited architectural documents and supplied hypothetical case; no bank implementation evidence supplied.
evidence.date_or_recency: Analysis 2026-10-05; assumed pilot and maintenance horizons.
evidence.notes: A design hypothesis requiring comparison against direct APIs, not a measured benefit or deployment approval.

contrary_evidence_or_limitations: REST concerns distributed hypermedia; MCP concerns AI context and tool exchange. Their different interfaces and execution semantics limit analogy. No longitudinal adoption evidence was collected to explain REST’s commercial success.
A direct API client with explicitly mapped tool definitions and orchestration is an alternative; an MCP adapter may add cost without useful reuse in a single-host pilot.
The sources establish mechanisms and creator intent, not measured bank navigation savings, current ecosystem adoption counts, security certification, or future protocol survival.

Bank-specific callable interfaces, permission delegation, auditability, freshness guarantees, eligibility semantics, staffing and evaluation data are missing. Read-only access and assumed human review do not establish safe disclosure or correct explanations.
confidence_and_uncertainty: High confidence in the verified dated launch, predecessor sequence, and published architectural descriptions. Moderate confidence in interpreting fragmented integrations as a plausible economic driver, because creator intent is stronger evidence than independently measured causal benefit. Low confidence in exact-specification durability over three years and in organization-specific value or feasibility without interface and pilot evidence. Current documentation supports a versioned description, not a claim of ecosystem-wide implementation. No bank controls were verified.
value_opportunity_implication: Potential value lies in reducing repeated agent-facing integration work and making existing information easier for bankers to retrieve. Investigate whether the same approved backend operations can serve more than one intended host without duplicating bank logic. Measure navigation effort, retrieval correctness, explanation fidelity and adapter maintenance against the direct-API alternative before treating reuse as realized value; no savings estimate is supported.
risk_governance_implication: The adapter adds another implementation and permission boundary; the organizational consequences make correctness, access scope and information freshness material. Ask appropriate security, compliance and system owners to assess those matters. Proposed controls are subjects for investigation, not verified controls: narrowly scoped read-only permissions, authoritative eligibility results, traceable source/version information, and review of misleading explanations. Protocol conformance cannot certify regulatory approval or financial suitability.
recommendation_management_implication: Investigate a reversible comparison using synthetic data first: expose a small set of existing approved read-only operations through an MCP adapter and through a direct API route, preserving shared bank-owned logic and backend contracts. Pin mutually supported versions and record actual compatibility and maintenance effort. If approved callable access is absent, resolve that architectural gap before claiming either route feasible. Continue only within a separately authorized pilot and specialist review; this creation analysis does not approve production deployment or provide financial product advice.
change_monitoring_triggers: A supported MCP specification or SDK change modifies discovery, invocation, authorization integration, or backward compatibility in the intended hosts.
Documented tests show the same tools work, or fail, across the bank’s intended independent host implementations without changes to bank logic.
Legacy-system owners document new, removed, or changed approved callable interfaces, eligibility semantics, freshness behavior or permission mechanisms.
Pilot comparison produces observed differences in integration effort, retrieval correctness, explanation fidelity or maintenance between MCP and direct APIs.
An intended host withdraws support for the pinned version or a credible alternative offers verified interoperability with lower switching cost.
abstention_or_more_information_needed: Provide approved interface documentation, authentication and permission delegation architecture, audit capabilities, and constraints on customer-data use before asserting compatibility or control adequacy.
Provide authoritative promotion/eligibility semantics, freshness requirements and the documented basis for potential-savings explanations; do not substitute inferred rules.
Provide intended hosts and supported versions, integration staffing, existing connector assets and comparison measurements before estimating value or maintenance burden.

Refer readiness, security/compliance certification, diffusion forecasts, procurement and production adoption decisions to appropriate specialists. A contrast case is needed for the instructed cross-case test; this file contains the supplied primary case only.
